from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's total profit for the reported period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    total_profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The total profit amount as reported, negative if loss")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency or unit if specified (e.g. CNY, 元)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g. 2024 Q1)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the profit amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
